purpose: Zero-input T2/T4 full-path audit and controlled caller-buffer allocation experiment

reference.buffered_rss: SDK memory-input/memory-output probe; final control compiled with -DZ7_LARGE_PAGES

scope: Linux x86-64, level 5, zero-filled 256 MiB, T2/T4 only. Caller buffer changes are diagnostic; library source and original buffered probe are unchanged.
method: Nine interleaved runs per arm per thread budget; complete-process monotonic wall time and wait4 user + system CPU and peak RSS. Phase probes use process getrusage and monotonic time.
limitations: Phase batches are diagnostic: waiting controllers and occasional collection requests ran outside benchmark children. Final uninstrumented stage started after both earlier stages finished.
No profile timing is used. C probes supply matched buffered RSS; official 7zz supplies wall and CPU denominators.
Initial C control omitted Z7_LARGE_PAGES; both original and corrected controls are preserved.
Original baseline Zen 4 T4 exceeded 3% wall in the first two batches. Later better measurements do not erase those failures.
Huge-page advice before filling the caller-owned buffer changes caller input policy. It does not establish an improvement inside the borrowed-slice encoder API.
Only the huge-page diagnostic requires Linux and successful MADV_HUGEPAGE; this is not a general-purpose file reader.

import subprocess,json,time,os,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
rows=[]
arms=['buffered','stream','7zz','sdk-buffered','phase-buffered','phase-stream','phase-read']
for n in range(9):
 for threads in ([2,4] if n%2==0 else [4,2]):
  order=arms[n%len(arms):]+arms[:n%len(arms)]
  if n%2:order=order[::-1]
  for arm in order:
   if arm=='7zz':cmd=['repo/target/sevenzip/7zz','a','-txz','-mx5','-mmt'+str(threads),'-mf=off','-so','unused.xz','zeros256.bin']
   elif arm.startswith('phase-'):cmd=['./phase',arm[6:],str(threads),'zeros256.bin']
   else:cmd=['./'+arm,'2',str(threads),'zeros256.bin']
   with tempfile.TemporaryFile() as out,tempfile.TemporaryFile() as err:
    start=time.monotonic();child=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=out if arm!='7zz' else subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=err)
    _,status,u=os.wait4(child.pid,0);elapsed=time.monotonic()-start;child.returncode=os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status)
    if child.returncode:err.seek(0);raise RuntimeError(err.read().decode())
    out.seek(0);result=out.read().decode()
   row=dict(arm=arm,run=n,threads=threads,wall=elapsed,user=u.ru_utime,system=u.ru_stime,cpu=u.ru_utime+u.ru_stime,rss_kib=u.ru_maxrss,minor_faults=u.ru_minflt,major_faults=u.ru_majflt,voluntary_switches=u.ru_nvcsw,involuntary_switches=u.ru_nivcsw)
   if arm.startswith('phase-'):row['detail']=json.loads(result)
   else:row['stdout']=result
   rows.append(row);Path('round10/results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows));print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)

   rows.append(row);Path('round10/final-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows));print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)

round10-bootstrap.sh.text:
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq build-essential curl git python3 xz-utils time > /tmp/bootstrap-apt.log 2>&1
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain 1.97.1 --profile minimal
export PATH=/root/.cargo/bin:$PATH RUSTUP_HOME=/root/.rustup CARGO_HOME=/root/.cargo
mkdir -p /opt/lzma-perf
cd /opt/lzma-perf
cat /tmp/lzma-round10-part-* | base64 -d | tar xz
mkdir -p repo round10
tar xzf round10/repo.tar.gz -C repo
cp round10/phase.rs repo/examples/phase_probe.rs
cp round10/buffered.rs repo/examples/perf_probe.rs
cp round10/stream.rs repo/examples/stream_probe.rs
(cd repo && cargo build --locked --profile profiling --no-default-features --features std,enc,asm --example perf_probe --example stream_probe --example phase_probe) > round10/build.log 2>&1
cp repo/target/profiling/examples/perf_probe buffered
cp repo/target/profiling/examples/stream_probe stream
cp repo/target/profiling/examples/phase_probe phase
(cd repo && cargo run --locked -p xtask -- sevenzip) > round10/sevenzip.log 2>&1
(cd repo && cargo run --locked -p xtask -- lzma-util) > round10/sdk.log 2>&1
sdk=repo/target/lzma-util/sdk/C
cc -O2 -D_GNU_SOURCE -pthread -I "$sdk" round10/sdk.c "$sdk/Alloc.c" "$sdk/CpuArch.c" "$sdk/LzFind.c" "$sdk/LzFindMt.c" "$sdk/LzFindOpt.c" "$sdk/LzmaEnc.c" "$sdk/Lzma2Enc.c" "$sdk/MtCoder.c" "$sdk/MtDec.c" "$sdk/7zStream.c" "$sdk/Threads.c" -o sdk-buffered
truncate -s 268435456 zeros256.bin
lscpu > round10/lscpu.txt
sha256sum buffered stream phase sdk-buffered repo/target/sevenzip/7zz > round10/binaries.sha256
python3 round10/measure.py > round10/measure.log 2>&1

set -eu
cd /opt/lzma-perf
export PATH=/root/.cargo/bin:$PATH RUSTUP_HOME=/root/.rustup CARGO_HOME=/root/.cargo
base64 -d > repo/examples/buffered_huge.rs <<'PAYLOAD'

PAYLOAD
base64 -d > round10/final-measure.py <<'PAYLOAD'

PAYLOAD
(cd repo && cargo build --locked --profile profiling --no-default-features --features std,enc,asm --example buffered_huge) > round10/build-buffered-huge.log 2>&1
cp repo/target/profiling/examples/buffered_huge buffered-huge

for t in 2 4; do
 ./buffered 2 "$t" zeros256.bin round10/baseline-$t.raw

 sha256sum round10/huge-$t.raw >> round10/parity.sha256
done
